notes.title: New challenges in version 25.32.0!
notes.notes: [h1]New challenges in version 25.32.0![/h1][p][/p][p]Hello everyone![/p][p]It’s been a while since the last release, but I can finally share with you all the new features I’ve been passionately working on.[/p][p]The game has now taken its desired shape, so from this point on I will focus primarily on optimization, bug fixes, and adding engaging details.[/p][p][/p][h2]Main Changes[/h2][p]Over the past months, patch after patch, I’ve completely overhauled the interfaces to make the experience more modern and enjoyable. Here’s what you’ll find in this update:[/p][list][*][p][b]Main menu[/b] redesigned with an optimized layout;[/p][/*][*][p]Updated icons for the [b]game modes[/b];[/p][/*][*][p][b]Options menu[/b] with more colorful accents;[/p][/*][*][p][b]Sandbox menu interface[/b] refined (visible when at least one Level Set from the Steam Workshop is active);[/p][/*][*][p]Improvements to the [b]Sandbox mode UI[/b] for smoother navigation;[/p][/*][*][p][b]Player timer[/b] moved to the top center for instant glanceability;[/p][/*][*][p]New icons in [b]dialogs[/b].[/p][/*][/list][p]These changes are complemented by minor graphical and functional tweaks designed to significantly enhance usability.[/p][list][*][p][b]Expanded language support[/b]: introduced a dedicated font for Chinese (Simplified and Traditional), Korean, and Japanese;[/p][/*][*][p][b]Speedrun Mode[/b]: time is now measured only in minutes and seconds (goodbye to unnecessary hours!);[/p][/*][*][p][b]Sandbox[/b]: interface revamp to simplify operations, with new keyboard shortcuts. Be sure to check out the in-game guide.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed several bugs.[/p][p] [/p][/*][/list][h2]But that’s not all…[/h2][p]It’s time to unveil the [b]new additions[/b] that will make your experience even richer![/p][p][/p][h2]New Game Additions[/h2][h3]Barrier (solid)[/h3][p]Different from the standard barrier, this block remains hidden until the Player approaches, guaranteeing a surprise effect.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44982898/7aae0373aa9766fab47bb372f44665640abad483.png"][/img] [/p][h3]A New Story[/h3][p]Level sharing, Speedrun competitions, and player interaction: these are the elements I consider fundamental. That’s why I’m excited to introduce the mode I’m most proud of to date.[/p][p][/p][h2]Playroom: the Game Room[/h2][p]Up to four players can compete in four different [b]minigames[/b], each more fun than the last:[/p][list][*][p][b]Bulb Rush[/b]: touch the bulbs to color them; whoever lights up the most within the time limit wins;[/p][/*][*][p][b]Vertical Run[/b]: a vertical race; whoever reaches the portal first triumphs;[/p][/*][*][p][b]Hide'n'Seek[/b]: reduced visibility and a secret seeker; if the seeker finds everyone, they win; otherwise, the hiders win;[/p][/*][*][p][b]Maze Escape[/b]: invisible maze with unique paths for each player; the fastest one claims victory.[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][h2]Available Now![/h2][p]All these new features are [b]already integrated[/b] into the game. Don’t wait: download or update it, and let me know what you think of the evolution of [b]PHOTOBIA: Tales from the Dark[/b]![/p][p]See you soon![/p]

notes.title: Race against time in Patch 25.28.0!
notes.notes: [h1]Race against time in Patch 25.28.0![/h1][p][/p][p]Hey everyone![/p][p]Over the past few months, I've been diving into all sorts of experiments, and the best ones are now part of this patch. There’s still a lot brewing behind the scenes, but as you know, magic potions take time.[/p][p][/p][h2]Main changes[/h2][p]The main interface screens have been redesigned for a cleaner look, without giving up clarity and ease of use. In particular:[/p][list][*][p]Pause menu;[/p][/*][*][p]Workshop level set menu;[/p][/*][*][p]Game mode selection menu;[/p][/*][*][p]Level selection menu.[/p][/*][/list][p]Additional minor tweaks help unify the style across various sections.[/p][p][/p][h2]But that’s not all...[/h2][p]It’s time to unveil a brand new [b]game mode[/b]![/p][p][/p][h2]A new tale: Speedrun Mode[/h2][p]You can now compete in PHOTOBIA: Tales from the Dark! Challenge players from around the world, climb the timed leaderboards of the most demanding levels, and race against the clock - [i]and more[/i] - to earn your glory![/p][p]In this mode, you'll take on a set of levels that includes both [b]Story Mode[/b] and [b]Escape[/b] levels![/p][p][/p][h2]Minor changes and fixes[/h2][list][*][p]Adjusted the character's hitbox to prevent unwanted sliding along the edges of blocks and platforms.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed several inconsistencies in menu translations.[/p][/*][*][p]Squashed lots... and lots of bugs.[/p][p] [/p][/*][/list][h2]Available now![/h2][p]All new features are already in the game: download or update [b]PHOTOBIA: Tales from the Dark[/b] now and let me know what you think of the project’s evolution![/p][p]See you soon![/p]

notes.title: Lots of new content in Patch 25.17.0!
notes.notes:
[h1]Lots of new content in Patch 25.17.0![/h1]

Hello everyone!

In the month following the game's release, I've had time to reflect and experiment with [b]new ideas[/b] that I'm finally ready to share with you.

[h2]Main changes[/h2]
[list]
[*][b]Revamped several interfaces[/b]: the game mode menu now features more appealing button designs; the Sandbox menu has been completely redesigned, with a new system for displaying level sets; some elements of the Sandbox interface have also been refined.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44982898/2467508facdfaed1aa3bd4031e963058193301af.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44982898/825e0430b4085443bd0beb5cd6dcebcd423cd7b5.png[/img]
[*][b]Added sound effects[/b] for Temporary Blocks and Propulsor Blocks.
[*]The button for Hardcore mode will no longer appear at the end of the Echo level, but only after completing the entire Story Mode.
[/list]
[h2]But that’s not all...[/h2]
It’s time to talk about the [b]new additions[/b]!

[h2]New in-game additions[/h2]
[h3]New [b]blocks[/b][/h3]
[list][*][b]Bulb[/b]: a block that can emit light... or darkness.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44982898/a31f01ef80a42da9a95e802795dacff08853a5db.png[/img]
[*][b]Block (key)[/b]: can only be removed using a key.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44982898/92a663e3b6e39355a4bd7f4a2e4c4eb05c064987.png[/img][/list]
[h3][b]Key[/b][/h3]
Once you approach a key, it will start to follow you until it finds a Key Block to unlock.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44982898/0c246626b39ad37d44191b83082b851e8d569625.png[/img]
[h3][b]Dead Singularity[/b][/h3]
The Dead Singularity is what remains of a collapsed Singularity: it expands endlessly, [b]destroying everything in its path[/b].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44982898/3e89bf7db71600941e5a94ccb3fdb37553c84674.png[/img]
[h3][b]Hourglass[/b][/h3]
The Hourglass is born from the collision of two Prisms, which fused to generate an object capable of enabling passage between different dimensions of light... but only for a [b]limited time[/b].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44982898/5ad467740a252d16a2125ffe2225f58319e79d0b.png[/img]
[h2]A new tale[/h2]
The new content arrives with [b]two new game modes[/b]: [b]Escape[/b] and [b]Permadeath[/b], two sides of the same nightmare.

In the first, you must escape from a crumbling realm determined to hold you back by any means. In the second, you’ll face an extreme challenge where [b]every mistake has real and permanent consequences[/b].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44982898/8ea7b34b70766d55811f4a1fdb748171f9c0d4f8.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44982898/df8810327bde5f287c305a38669d95c204e136f2.png[/img]
[h2]Minor changes and fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*]Changed the number of charges of an Orb in the Veritas level: from 3 to 5.
[*]Slightly reduced block collision to minimize the “floating player” effect.
[*]Also reduced the collisions of Singularities.
[*]Fixed some translations that weren’t displaying correctly.
[*]Propulsor Blocks now stop slightly farther from platforms, preventing the risk of getting stuck.
[*]Fixed several bugs.
[*]Changed the system for indicating game versions; from now on it will be [i]year.week.version[/i].
[/list]
[h2]Available now![/h2]
All these features are [b]already integrated[/b] into the game. Don’t waste time: download or update it, and let me know what you think about the evolution of [b]PHOTOBIA: Tales from the Dark[/b]!

See you soon!

notes.title: Release Date Announcement for PHOTOBIA: Tales from the Dark
notes.notes:
[h1]Release Date Announcement for [i]PHOTOBIA: Tales from the Dark[/i][/h1]

Hello everyone!

The moment has finally arrived: [i]PHOTOBIA: Tales from the Dark[/i] will be available on Steam starting on [b]March 21, 2025 at 18:00 CET[/b]!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44982898/08102fa0d907b9b884c64cc098af4dcd62228b5f.png[/img]

The game has reached the point I envisioned it to be. I am extremely satisfied with the result and cannot wait to share it with all of you. However, this does not mean that the journey ends here: there will be [b]improvements and new additions in the future[/b], also based on your feedback.

[b]All future updates and additional content will always be free for those who own the game[/b]. No paid extra content: I want every player to experience [i]PHOTOBIA: Tales from the Dark[/i] in its entirety and as an ever-evolving adventure.

The most important news will be announced here on Steam, but if you want to discover extra content and insights into the development process, you can also follow me on the social channels listed below.

Thank you for your support: see you on March 21 as we explore together the darkness of this mysterious world!

See you soon!
